'''July 2001 Colorado Springs tournament (22 July)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Hobby Town, Colorado Springs, Colorado on 22 July 2001. [[Derek Mower]] won it. It is known from Patrick Napier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2711">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-25-colorado-springs-a-dark-time-7-22-01d2711/ colorado-springs-a-dark-time-7-22-01], DeckTech (Patrick "Pappy" Napier, 25 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-25-colorado-springs-a-dark-time-7-22-01d2711/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Hobby Town, Colorado Springs, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Derek Mower]]
